QuestInfo.0:
Use a Lv. 3 or higher Hologram skill 25 times.
Must be completed within a single dungeon attempt.
To obtain Hologram skills, equip special equipment in the Quanah world.
You will receive a piece of Quanah's Hologram equipment as a separate additional reward upon completing the quest.
